description.narrative: General improved access to finance and ability to implement capital expenditures at the farm level with multi-year payback periods, including investments required to obtain certification or to renovate the coffee plantation stock. Sustainability of Central America Coffee Production. Improved coffee farm productivity with higher yield, higher quality plants, improved traceability of coffee and E&S practices on the farms, improved farmers income and plantation sustainability in the long term. Demonstration effect of the replanting of better performing varieties for other farmers to plant and other financiers to support.

The coffee sector in Central America (and Nicaragua in particular) is dominated by small holders, and has been suffering from decreasing productivity over the past decade. The proceeds of the loans provided by IFC will be used to fund ECOM Agroindustrial Corp. Ltds (ECOM or the Company) coffee operations in Nicaragua, Honduras, Guatemala and Costa Rica, and are aimed at on-lending to coffee growers for seasonal expenses, harvest, productivity and certification expenditures, and plantation renovation to help the Borrowers coffee suppliers in those countries access short term and medium term financing, improve their productivity and adopt best management practices.
